title: Preserve the original busy error when control transaction rollback also fails
outcome: Preserve the original busy error when control transaction rollback also fails
acceptance: When a control transaction body returns SQLite BUSY or LOCKED and its explicit rollback fails, the operation still returns generic storage_error and preserves the original body error alongside useful rollback-failure context in diagnostics; no control_store_busy no-commit certification is issued.
Regression coverage proves both error provenance and generic classification for rollback failure, while successful explicit rollback keeps the existing control_store_busy classification.
